jobs.title: Product Manager - International Strategy & Product Management
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
International Strategy and Product Management (ISPM) is responsible for creating exceptional product experience worldwide. We drive discovery, adoption, and growth of our Creative Cloud (CC) and Document Cloud (DC) products in new markets.

We are seeking a Product Manager to lead the international expansion and adoption of DC's AI-powered agentic products and services. You will collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, GTM, and local sales teams to drive our international product strategy. You will guide the product roadmap and prioritization, create market-ready experience, and measure impact. You will help the teams strike the right balance between scalable and local!

This is a high visibility position with responsibility for developing strategic product level recommendations that have substantial subscription unit and financial impact. As such, it provides significant professional development and excellent growth potential for the right person. As Adobe's vision for agentic workflows becomes a reality, this role requires deep customer empathy, strong market knowledge across key verticals, and the ability to uncover insights from user workflows to drive product innovation and growth.

What you'll Do
- Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap for GenAI-powered experiences, driving measurable business outcomes across priority international markets.

- Leverage user, product, financial, competitive, and market insights to build data-driven product strategy, prioritize investments, and secure executive alignments across key international markets.

- Drive validation of end-to-end use cases, user journeys, and workflows to identify internationalization gaps, establish product readiness criteria, and prioritize opportunities for expansion into new markets.

- Partner with engineering, build, marketing, GTM, sales, and regional collaborators to align priorities and drive successful product execution.

- Define success metrics and monitor product performance to measure impact, inform decisions, and continuously optimize market outcomes.

What you'll need to succeed
- 3-5+ years of experience in product management, software development, or management consulting.

- Proven track record of defining product requirements and delivering successful products. Experience launching products or services from concept to 1.0.

- Demonstrable GenAI proficiency, ongoing AI skill development, and staying current with emerging AI technologies. Experience building AI-native products or GenAI powered products is a strong plus.

- Experience engaging directly with customers across B2C and B2B environments, building positive relationships, uncovering needs, and incorporating customer insights into product strategy and execution. Experience in user experience survey, interview, and research tools (Qualtrics, UserTesting).

- Strategic and data-driven product problem solver who uses customer, market, product, and business insights to make informed product decisions and navigate ambiguous problem spaces.

Preferred Experience
- BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar area (or equivalent experience); MBA preferred.

- Experience with LLMs and agentic systems, including timely engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and evaluation.

- Language (Portuguese and/or Spanish) and cultural proficiency in the LATAM region is a plus!

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Growth Product Manager – Adobe Experience Cloud

The Opportunity
Adobe Experience Cloud enables enterprises to deliver personalized, data-driven digital experiences at scale. We are seeking a Senior Growth Product Manager to drive Product-Led Growth (PLG) across Experience Cloud products by accelerating user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion.
This role is ideal for a growth leader with deep experience in B2B SaaS and Digital Marketing Technology , who thrives at the intersection of product, experimentation and data. You will drive and implement growth strategies across key user journeys, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Go-To-Market teams to turn customer insight into scalable growth engines.

What You’ll Do

Growth Strategy & Lifecycle Management
- Drive and evolve end-to-end growth strategies across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion for an Experience Cloud product.
- Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using data, research and experimentation.
- Develop and prioritize a growth roadmap tied to clear business impact.

Experimentation & Optimization
- Design, launch, and analyze a high-velocity experimentation program across critical user journeys.
- Drive rapid test-and-learn cycles that ensure rigorous experiment design by establishing clear hypotheses, calculating statistical power, and implementing appropriate guardrails.
- Collaborate with engineering and data teams to build robust instrumentation for accurate measurement and monitoring. Oversee careful rollout strategies—including phased launches, A/B testing, and control groups—to minimize risk and improve actionable insights.

Technology-Based Growth Initiatives
- Identify, prioritize, and ship product experiences powered by advanced technology that improve conversion and retention—e.g., personalization, predictive mentorship, and intelligent onboarding.
- Use AI to speed up experiment ideation, hypothesis generation, copy/variant drafting, and analysis—while maintaining statistical rigor and human review.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner with cross-functional leaders to co-develop and implement growth initiatives, navigating trade-offs and driving alignment across teams
- Proven ability to influence product roadmaps and drive outcomes in a matrixed environment without direct authority
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning multiple teams around shared goals

Work in close coordination with:
- Product Leaders who own core product to co-develop and implement a growth roadmap
- Engineering to implement experimentation infrastructure
- Design & UX Research to optimize onboarding and feature discovery
- Marketing to align product growth levers with acquisition strategies
- Finance & Data Science to quantify business impact

What You Need to Succeed
- 5+ years of Growth Product Management experience, with significant focus on experimentation-driven optimization.
- Proven experience driving B2B Product-Led Growth in SaaS or Digital Marketing Technology platforms.
- Experience implementing and executing experimentation tools.
- Deep expertise in experimentation frameworks, behavioral analytics, funnel optimization, and cohort analysis.
- Solid understanding of enterprise customer journeys, including self-serve, sales-assisted, and hybrid motions.
- Fluency in applying AI to product discovery, experimentation, and growth workflows, with a commitment to continuous skill development.
- Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools for accelerating prototyping and insight generation.
- Demonstrated ability to translate data and customer insight into shipped product experiences with measurable impact.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize insights into clear narratives that drive action.

Most Importantly
You value outcomes over activity, learning over certainty, and are deeply customer obsessed. You believe Product-Led Growth is an operating model, not a feature, and you thrive in environments where experimentation, insight, and collaboration drive impact.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to have you help shape the future of Experience Cloud.

The Opportunity

Privacy is changing quickly. People are more aware of their privacy rights and want more control over their data, especially as AI has become part of our everyday work. We are looking for a collaborative and innovative Lead Product Manager to guide the strategy and execution of our vision for experiential privacy. You will need to think strategically, influence others, and work closely with teams across Adobe, including Creativity & Productivity, Customer Experience Orchestration, Adobe Unified Platform Engineering, Digital Employee Experience, and Legal. To succeed, you are comfortable with change, act with urgency, take ownership, and deliver results while partnering with multiple teams and managing competing priorities.

What You'll Do
- Understand needs around data protection and privacy compliance in our products, services and platforms.

- Build, document and communicate key use cases as the basis for comprehensive, end-to-end features and user acceptance testing for privacy requirements and solutions.

- Partner with legal to assist in the review of privacy impact assessments for different platforms, products, tools, and services.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

In the last 6 months, agentic development has taken off – changing how software is built. We have a clear vision on how to embrace it, and an engineering org already in motion. We need a product leader to take the spark and own the connection with the builders we serve. They will turn it into strategy and keep evolving that strategy as frameworks, tools, and processes change.

Join us in the ABX org, where agentic development is the platform – a managed harness that 15,000 builders at Adobe will use to ship software with AI. Every improvement you will make compounds across engineering, product, and design, on most codebases at Adobe!

This is a build role. You'll develop the strategy, build the organizational framework from the ground up, and set the bar for what agentic development looks like at Adobe.

What you'll own

The Builders Experience strategy. Take an articulated-but-evolving vision and transform it into written strategy, roadmap, and objective measures of success. Expect it to change continuously as the models, harnesses, and internal processes evolve.

The platform spanning all three modes of agentic development. ABX will serve builders wherever they are on the curve, and make each mode repeatable:
- Agentic Delegation - individual acceleration; the SDLC stays the same, each function just gets faster.
- Agentic Transformation - cross-functional AI pods that compress the SDLC and dissolve role boundaries.
- Agentic Orchestration - ticket-to-PR factories, multi-agent loops, self-healing CI, with customer and SRE signal closing the outer loop.

The objectives and key results (OKRs). Platform adoption → per-engineer output → per-employee productivity → business impact. We start with adoption and build up to the rest.

The relationship with the builders. Deepen trust with the Adobe Builders community, as past decisions on models and tooling created friction. You'll build the engagement mechanisms for a real partnership, and act as chief marketer and evangelist for the platform across the org!

Build vs. buy. Own the decision process for which external models and tools we deploy. Know the latest across the labs, hyperscalers, and open-weights - and make high-conviction calls amid an embarrassment of riches.

Execution. Relentless focus on shipping. Remove bottlenecks, streamline how the team communicates, and automate our own SDLC intelligently - designing the moments where humans stay in the loop so judgment and taste get applied at the junctures that matter.

The operating model. Design how this team runs, in partnership with engineering. It must be agentic itself - we build the system with our system and eat our own dog food. Expect AI pods with real ownership, some led by non-PMs and product-design-engineer (PDE) profiles, not the classic backlog-and-execute approach.

A small PM team. Direct one PM today (who owns external-tool deployment decisions) and grow the org as the mandate expands - setting the hiring bar and the culture as you go.

What you'll bring
- Senior PM leadership with a track record of building strategy and teams from scratch
- Technical credibility with builders. The best instinct here is an engineer's instinct for what engineers want - we're building tools for people who like to build their own tools. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read it and reason about it.
- Deep technical fluency in agentic systems: model evaluation and selection, orchestration frameworks, evaluations, inference cost, MCP and the surrounding dev-tooling stack. Comfortable debating latency-vs-accuracy tradeoffs with principal engineers.
- Strategic clarity under ambiguity. The landscape shifts weekly; you will synthesize signal from noise, make high-conviction bets on incomplete information, and adjust course as needed.
- Comfort operating lean and unconventionally - small team, novel AI pods structure, strong bias to action, allergic to process theater and fluff.
- A driver of reinvention - energized by collapsing role boundaries and remaking the SDLC to be AI-first.

What sets you apart
- You've led product for a developer or AI platform inside a large engineering org (hundreds to thousands of engineers), and driven adoption of AI-augmented development tooling at scale.
- You're boundary-less - you'll collaborate across Adobe and go where the outcome takes you.
- You can converse across the whole agentic stack: agentic coding, CI/CD, build systems, observability, evaluations, orchestration.
- A technical degree (CS, Math, Engineering, or related) or equivalent experience. We value what you've built over where you studied.

Be ready for
- A vision that will change, repeatedly. We optimize for agility over certainty.
- A team that's small by design, with a non-standard operating model you'll co-invent.
- Being both architect and customer of what we build. That reinforcement loop - the system building itself, and getting smarter every time Adobe builds on it - is our MO.

The Opportunity

Adobe's communications team helps define how the world understands Adobe by showcasing our products, innovation, and customer and industry impact for media, creators, partners, and the broader market. We're looking for an experienced and strategic Director of Product Communications to lead messaging and media across the product portfolio, including Acrobat, Express, Firefly, Illustrator, Lightroom, Photoshop, Premiere and the Creative Cloud suite. You'll manage a team responsible for delivering high-impact communications strategies that speak to customers, move media, and achieve results for Adobe's largest business.

- Own Adobe's core product narratives with an emphasis on what generative AI innovation means for customers and industries, from business professionals and consumers to creators and creative professionals.
